document.title: KickStream Frontend UI/UX and Design Specification
document.scope: Public marketing funnel, authentication experience, guest contact affordances, chat widget UX, and admin entry surface.

experienceGoals.brandIntent: Convey premium, high-energy football streaming with editorial boldness, focused clarity, and modern confidence.
userGoals: Understand the KickStream value proposition immediately
Move from discovery to login/contact with minimal friction
See real-time match context and live engagement signals
Use guest support and WhatsApp contact without creating friction
Access chat and account context quickly after authentication
uxPrinciples: High visual contrast with a restrained yet athletic palette
Strong typography hierarchy for instant scanning on desktop and mobile
Progressive disclosure to keep marketing and support actions distinct
Fast visual feedback for async actions and socket state changes
Mobile-first touch ergonomics for key conversion and chat controls

usageRules: Use cream/off-white backgrounds for content-heavy sections
Use near-black for primary readability and framing
Reserve orange for kinetic highlights, emphasis, and progress
Reserve green for positive action states (send, WhatsApp, connected states)

display.role: Hero headlines, section headers, compact loud labels

hierarchyPattern: Uppercase micro-labels with letter spacing for section framing
Readable body copy with medium contrast

shapeAndDepth.borders: Frequent 2px hard borders to maintain editorial mechanical framing
shapeAndDepth.radius: Mostly square/low radius except chat/action pills
shapeAndDepth.shadows: Offset editorial shadows and soft functional shadows
shapeAndDepth.texture: Subtle texture overlay + gradient vignettes for atmosphere

motionLanguage.entry: Staggered word reveal and delayed content fade
motionLanguage.feedback: Button hover shifts, subtle pulse on key floating actions
motionLanguage.timing: Short and decisive for controls, slower for hero drama

behavior: Desktop horizontal links with primary CTA
nav.uxIntent: Keep focus on hero at top, then reveal navigation when user is ready to explore deeper.
nav.mobileNotes: Menu uses large touch targets and clear typographic hierarchy.

hero.content: Statement headline, kickoff timing line, primary CTA, and live-match framing.

mediaStrategy.desktop: Autoplay looping background video with poster fallback and progressive loading
mediaStrategy.mobile: Autoplay looping mobile-optimized video with muted inline playback protections

hero.uxIntent: Deliver emotional impact in the first viewport while preserving text legibility and fast entry for mobile users.
riskAndMitigation: Large media payload risk mitigated through poster fallback and optimization pipeline
Autoplay restrictions mitigated by muted+inline+retry strategy
Hero content remains readable when video is paused or blocked

trustBar.design: A lightweight credibility strip with performance indicators and brand trust cues.
trustBar.uxIntent: Reinforce confidence quickly with compact trust signals before deeper exploration.
trustBar.behavior: Visible under hero on desktop and within page flow on mobile.

productReveal.design: Feature-focused cards with concise benefit statements and supporting icons.
productReveal.uxIntent: Communicate core capabilities in a scannable layout that supports comparison and engagement.
productReveal.interaction: Cards are paced with consistent spacing and subtle hover states.

howItWorks.design: Step-by-step flow that demonstrates setup and engagement in clear phases.
howItWorks.uxIntent: Reduce friction by breaking the process into digestible actions and visual milestones.
howItWorks.mobileNotes: Each step stacks cleanly with accessible spacing and labels.

stats.design: Value propositions presented as performance metrics, counters, and micro-data panels.
stats.uxIntent: Use data-driven credibility to support trust and urgency without overloading the page.
stats.motion: Animate counts on view for perceived momentum.

pricing.design: Four-term card-based plan comparison with a highlighted popular option and 1-day free trial messaging.
pricing.interaction: Primary CTA drives trial starts and direct contact with minimal choice friction.
pricing.uxIntent: Reduce cognitive load with clear term labels, strong price hierarchy, and approachable trial reassurance.

testimonials.design: Quote cards with clear attribution and selective star or badge cues.
testimonials.uxIntent: Build trust through relatable user stories anchored to the platform's sports focus.
testimonials.behavior: Keep testimonial text short and visually balanced.

liveMatchTicker.design: A compact update strip with match status, teams, and urgency markers.
liveMatchTicker.uxIntent: Surface live energy in a low-profile, repeatable section that strengthens the platform's real-time promise.
liveMatchTicker.interaction: Ticker state updates should update quietly without jarring layout shifts.

faq.design: Accordion-style FAQs with clear questions and concise answers.
faq.uxIntent: Provide quick clarity on common concerns without requiring page reloads.
faq.accessibility: Each toggle should expose aria-expanded state and preserve keyboard navigation.

finalCTA.design: A focused closing section with strong language and a single conversion action.
finalCTA.uxIntent: Capture attention after the page story has been told and reduce choice friction.
finalCTA.behavior: Keep the action visible on both desktop and mobile with generous hit area.

footer.design: Minimal utility footer with secondary links and a simple brand anchor.
footer.uxIntent: Provide a clean site endpoint and basic trust signals without competing with the main conversion flow.
footer.mobileNotes: Stack footer groups vertically for easy thumb access.

authPage.design: Split-brand experience on large screens, focused single-column form on mobile.
authPage.uxIntent: Prevent accidental privilege confusion and communicate role boundaries before submission.

chatWidget.placement: Bottom-right floating launcher with unread badge.
chatWidget.panel: Responsive fixed overlay with capped viewport height and safe-area spacing.
chatWidget.uxIntent: Preserve persistent support access without hijacking primary browsing tasks.

whatsappContactButton.behavior: Opens WhatsApp deep-link with prefilled message
whatsappContactButton.uxIntent: Offer zero-friction direct contact when account creation is a barrier.

Nav.purpose: Guide visitors through the marketing funnel and surface login/contact actions.
Nav.details: Desktop shows horizontal links, the main CTA remains prominent, and the header can become sticky or visible after scroll. Mobile collapses into a large, accessible menu with clean touch targets.
Nav.uxImpact: Maintains clarity without distracting from the hero, while still giving users easy access to essential sections and conversion actions.

Hero.purpose: Anchor the page with an emotionally engaging statement and fast access to signup or contact.
Hero.details: Combines a bold headline, supporting kicker text, and a strong primary CTA. A layered video/poster background supports the brand tone, with gradients and overlays preserving legibility.
Hero.uxImpact: Creates a compelling first impression and anchors the page story immediately, while keeping the call to action visible on load.

TrustBar.purpose: Provide quick credibility and proof points near the top of the funnel.
TrustBar.details: A narrow strip with subtle icons, stats, or trust statements. Designed to be visible without overwhelming the hero.
TrustBar.uxImpact: Boosts confidence before users commit to scrolling or clicking, especially on first visits.

ProductReveal.purpose: Explain the platform's core benefits in a scannable format.
ProductReveal.details: Uses feature cards or columns with short headlines, descriptive copy, and iconography. Supports both desktop grids and mobile stacked layouts.
ProductReveal.uxImpact: Helps users quickly understand what KickStream delivers, shortening the path from curiosity to action.

HowItWorks.purpose: Make the onboarding and usage process feel simple and predictable.
HowItWorks.details: Displays sequential steps with numbers or labels, concise copy, and visual rhythm. Each step is optimized for legibility on small screens.
HowItWorks.uxImpact: Reduces anxiety about setup by making the experience feel straightforward and attainable.

Stats.purpose: Reinforce the value proposition with tangible metrics.
Stats.details: Presents count-up numbers, user metrics, or performance indicators in a compact panel. Uses motion only as a supportive enhancement.
Stats.uxImpact: Adds credibility and momentum without creating distraction.

Pricing.purpose: Make subscription choice easy and actionable.
Pricing.details: Displays four-term plan cards with clear pricing, a highlighted recommended option, and direct CTA buttons. Each card emphasizes the 1-day free trial and term length.
Pricing.uxImpact: Reduces decision paralysis and guides users toward the option that best fits their timeline and commitment comfort.

Testimonials.purpose: Show social proof and real-user confidence.
Testimonials.details: Includes short quotes, user names or roles, and optional supporting visual cues. Maintains readability with ample spacing.
Testimonials.uxImpact: Strengthens trust with relatable voices without requiring users to read dense text.

LiveMatchTicker.purpose: Surface the platform's live sports relevance through real-time context.
LiveMatchTicker.details: A concise strip that highlights match progress, team names, and status. Should update seamlessly and remain unobtrusive.
LiveMatchTicker.uxImpact: Reminds visitors that KickStream is live-first, which supports urgency and the product narrative.

FAQ.purpose: Answer common questions with minimal effort.
FAQ.details: Uses collapsible panels or list items with clear labels and short answers. Includes keyboard-friendly navigation and visible state indicators.
FAQ.uxImpact: Helps users self-serve and reduces the need for support interruptions.

FinalCTA.purpose: Close the page with a strong, easy next step.
FinalCTA.details: Keeps a single high-contrast action visible, often with supportive copy that reinforces the primary offer.
FinalCTA.uxImpact: Transforms page interest into a clear action point when the story is complete.

Footer.purpose: Provide utility links and a calm visual endpoint.
Footer.details: Contains secondary navigation, brand information, and legal or contact links. Uses simplified layout on mobile.
Footer.uxImpact: Anchors the site without adding noise to the conversion flow.

AuthPage.purpose: Authenticate users with clear role separation and minimal friction.
AuthPage.details: Presents login fields with explicit user/admin context, error states, and action buttons. Mobile view simplifies layout while preserving clarity.
AuthPage.uxImpact: Reduces mistakes, improves confidence, and supports quick entry for returning users.

ChatWidget.purpose: Keep support and real-time conversation available throughout the user journey.
ChatWidget.details: A floating launcher opens a compact panel with a message list, entry field, and connection/status indicators. It supports inline send feedback and helps users feel heard.
ChatWidget.uxImpact: Makes the platform feel responsive and accessible without overshadowing the main page content.

WhatsAppContactButton.purpose: Offer a frictionless guest support channel.
WhatsAppContactButton.details: A floating action button that opens WhatsApp with a prefilled message. It is visible only to guests and designed for touch-friendly use.
WhatsAppContactButton.uxImpact: Removes barriers to contact and gives visitors an instant, familiar support option.

errorPatterns: Role mismatch and credential errors are explicit
Chat send failures surfaced directly in panel

breakpointIntent.mobile: Single-column, thumb-friendly controls, safe-area-aware floating UI
breakpointIntent.desktop: Expanded editorial composition with richer media

mobileHardeningImplemented: Auth page collapses to focused right-panel flow
Chat overlay dimensions constrained to viewport and safe area
knownConstraints: Heavy desktop hero source remains bandwidth-intensive until fully transcoded in CI/dev environment with ffmpeg

strengths: High color contrast in core text surfaces
gapsToAddress: Add reduced-motion handling for heavy animated regions
Audit keyboard focus styles across all interactive cards/links
Run full screen-reader pass on dynamic chat/notification regions
recommendedA11yEnhancements: Prefer aria-live regions for chat status/errors
Ensure all icon-only controls have descriptive labels
Use prefers-reduced-motion media query to simplify large hero transitions

currentCharacteristics: Code splitting is used for many marketing sections
Hero media is the dominant payload contributor
Realtime features add connection overhead post-auth
existingMitigations: Scripted optimization pipeline scaffold for hero videos
Conditional rendering of chat/guest actions based on auth state
nextOptimizations: Generate and commit optimized hero files via ffmpeg in CI/local pipeline
Adopt AV1/WebM secondary source where supported
Introduce route-level skeletons for perceived loading smoothness

uiMetrics.shadowEditorial: Offset hard shadow for brand personality
uiMetrics.shadowFunctional: Soft depth for overlays and floating controls

consistencyRules: Keep CTA verbs action-first and concise
Preserve role clarity in all auth-adjacent text
Use green for positive/send/contact actions, orange for highlight/progress
Prefer one visual focal point per section
changeReviewChecklist: Does this change keep guest vs authenticated action separation clear?
Is mobile tap target size at least 40-44px?
Do motion and media choices preserve readability and performance?
Are error states visible without console dependency?
